#: Base language. Every key in use must have a text here: other languages fall back to it.
#keys: A key is a latin label, never a sentence. Substitution is by name: %(name)s.
#adding: A new section goes into a NEW FILE in this folder - no existing file is rewritten.
#section: Settings: what is said when the path to somebody else's library is wrong, or the library is nowhere to be found. The names of the settings themselves are keys of morphbench.json - they are read by the code and are not texts.
config.pyniflyBadPath: the pynifly path in morphbench.json does not exist: %(path)s
config.pyniflyMissing: PyNifly add-on not found; name its folder with the pynifly key in %(config)s
